694:t_1:4.en:
$$赤木$$
「...So what exactly is this $$カオス・コスモス$$, anyway?」

694:t_1:5.en:
$$いぶき$$
「Apparently it's some parallel world, but even after broadcasting in every direction, we've had no replies from anywhere.」

694:t_1:6.en:
$$勝平$$
「Won't the $$御使い$$s find us if we do that?」

694:t_1:7.en:
$$青山$$
「We've been under their surveillance ever since we entered this universe, more or less. It's a little late to worry about that.」

694:t_1:8.en:
$$木下$$
「Ugh... That feels creepy. Maybe they can even see me sleeping or using the toilet.」

694:t_1:9.en:
$$柿小路$$
「Whenever $$木下$$ opens his mouth, the tension seems to melt away.」

694:t_1:10.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「What's wrong with that, Executive Director? We've got tough battles ahead whether we like it or not. We should relax while we can.」

694:t_1:11.en:
$$タケル$$
「$c is using this universe's properties to make repeated long-range jumps, tracing the $$御使い$$s' will.」

694:t_1:12.en:
$$甲児$$
「If we keep going like this, we'll run into them somewhere.」

694:t_1:13.en:
$$赤木$$
「Still, it's creepy that nobody is answering.」

694:t_1:14.en:
$$勝平$$
「Maybe... the $$御使い$$s and their servants are the only ones in this universe.」

694:t_1:18.en:
$$勝平$$
「Wh-what?! I was trying to follow $$木下$$'s example and help everyone relax!」

694:t_1:19.en:
$n
「You can't create that kind of atmosphere on purpose.」

694:t_1:20.en:
$$木下$$
「As expected of you, $n. Are you speaking from the experience of your own failures?」

694:t_1:23.en:
$$スズネ$$
(That troublesome side of him just never changes...)

694:t_1:24.en:
$$正太郎$$
「But we know for sure that we and the $$御使い$$s aren't the only ones in this universe.」

694:t_1:25.en:
$$タケル$$
「Dimension General $$ヴィルダーク$$... and $$アサキム・ドーウィン$$.」

694:t_1:26.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「So in the end, there's nobody here but enemies!」

694:t_1:29.en:
$$タケル$$
「I remembered that when $$ズール$$ and the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ appeared before, they said they needed to prepare before fighting us.」

694:t_1:30.en:
$$正太郎$$
「I remember, too. But although the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ and the others appeared after that, they never fought us.」

694:t_1:32.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Do you have some idea, $$グーラ$$?」

694:t_1:33.en:
$$ロゼ$$
「If something's bothering you, tell us.」

694:t_1:34.en:
$$グーラ$$
「...I think both Father and Emperor $$ズール$$ ultimately wanted to defeat the $$御使い$$s.」

694:t_1:35.en:
$$赤木$$
「That's how it seemed when the Galactic Raid Fleet set sail, too.」

694:t_1:36.en:
$$青山$$
「So they were trying to take Earth because they wanted to fight the $$御使い$$s, after all.」

694:t_1:37.en:
$$グーラ$$
「Perhaps the preparations Father and the others spoke of were for invading this $$カオス・コスモス$$...」

694:t_1:38.en:
$$タケル$$
「In other words, their goal was to have us wipe out $$バアル$$ and expose the $$天柱$$...」

694:t_1:39.en:
$$甲児$$
「They were trying to use our strength to get here.」

694:t_1:41.en:
$$グーラ$$
「The army of darkness has probably entered this $$カオス・コスモス$$, too.」

694:t_1:43.en:
$$スズネ$$
「The $$御使い$$s, $$アサキム$$, $$ヴィルダーク$$... Or perhaps...」

694:t_1:44.en:
$$甲児$$
「Whoever they are, they're still our enemies!」

694:t_1:45.en:
$$タケル$$
「Do we... have no choice but to fight...?」

695:t_000:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「...So this is the center of the galaxy, long shrouded in mystery.」

695:t_000:1.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「It's a perfectly empty stretch of space, isn't it?」

695:t_000:2.en:
$$尸刻$$
「The $$グレートアトラクター$$ that was here vanished into the gap between dimensions because of $c's $$時空震動弾$$.」

695:t_000:3.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「That isn't all that disappeared. $c themselves disappeared, too.」

695:t_000:4.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Knowing those people, I'm sure they're alive and well.」

695:t_000:6.en:
$$尸刻$$
「Yes... They must be heading toward $$サイデリアル$$'s rulers.」

695:t_000:8.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「His Majesty $$アウストラリス$$... So he challenges God, carrying the feelings Lady $$エルーナ$$ and the others entrusted to him...」

695:t_000:9.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Though $$サイデリアル$$ has already half collapsed, so calling him His Majesty is rather strange now.」

695:t_000:10.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「But even if $$サイデリアル$$ falls, the pride of $$ハイアデス$$ will never disappear...!」

695:t_000:11.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Since we survived, let's clear out the remaining $$バアル$$ and devote ourselves to cleaning up the aftermath.」

695:t_000:12.en:
$$尸刻$$
「Talks will soon begin with Earth, representatives of the organizations that joined the operation, and members of various species.」

695:t_000:13.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Earth defeated $$サイデリアル$$ and stopped $$バアル$$'s invasion. It will probably lead this galaxy...」

695:t_000:14.en:
$$尸刻$$
「The people of that planet held onto the indomitable fighting spirit and hope that were fading from the galaxy... That became a great power which defeated $$バアル$$.」

695:t_000:15.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「And the future was protected. A new era begins here.」

695:t_000:16.en:
$$サルディアス$$
(Of course, that's only if a merciless God permits humanity to exist.)

695:t_000:17.en:
$$サルディアス$$
(Your Majesty $$アウストラリス$$, everyone in $c... I pray one of you will somehow set things right...)

700:t_1:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
(Forgive me, $$ドゥリタラー$$, $$ウィルパーシャ$$... And $$ヴァイシュラバ$$...)

700:t_1:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
(I couldn't fulfill my duty as a Dimension General... Even if I meet you, all I can do is apologize...)

700:t_1:7.en:
???
「This is where the force that seeks to vanish and the force that seeks to exist intersect...」

700:t_1:8.en:
???
「There is still something you must do...」

700:t_1:13.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Do you have no intention of changing your mind?」

700:t_1:15.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Now that $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ has come back, let's have fun together again, all four of us.」

700:t_1:16.en:
???
「I have never once thought it was fun.」

700:t_1:17.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Do you intend to abandon your mission as a higher-dimensional life-form?」

700:t_1:19.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「What you have done is tantamount to rebellion against our very existence.」

700:t_1:21.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Very well, $$哀しみのサクリファイ$$. Then spend eternity inside this dimensional prison.」

700:t_1:22.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「That is our punishment for you.」
